<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This confuses recipients and erodes trust in communications.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Six accounts are affected, representing a total ARR of £5,580,000.0 [i:191159ac22dda8a3][i:3c348ad1d2e28b8c][i:45c010f06dcc57e3][i:666838190e575148][i:685a9720c023a304][i:784bbcdb220c64b5][i:7aef4ffdc807927e][i:8e8d4913f28f77f3][i:99cd195f0e22561c][i:99ed97781fb395fd][i:a493549d3d2021e9][i:a63d773b605f22e0][i:d407ed3449dc6468][i:e6dc24086d5b5b70][i:e81e5ea9868dbaf4][i:e9c39352aaac377c][i:f8fc05a94087512b].\n- The issue is reported via three routes: support, sales, and account management [i:191159ac22dda8a3][i:45c010f06dcc57e3][i:7aef4ffdc807927e].\n- Three accounts have renewals in the next 90 days: Stannary Commercial (2026-12-05), Tarnholt Drive Cover (2027-01-09), and Hollinbrook Home Insurance (2027-01-15) [i:685a9720c023a304][i:7aef4ffdc807927e][i:a63d773b605f22e0].\n\n## Evidence\n- There have been 17 mentions of this problem across the six accounts [i:191159ac22dda8a3][i:3c348ad1d2e28b8c][i:45c010f06dcc57e3][i:666838190e575148][i:685a9720c023a304][i:784bbcdb220c64b5][i:7aef4ffdc807927e][i:8e8d4913f28f77f3][i:99cd195f0e22561c][i:99ed97781fb395fd][i:a493549d3d2021e9][i:a63d773b605f22e0][i:d407ed3449dc6468][i:e6dc24086d5b5b70][i:e81e5ea9868dbaf4][i:e9c39352aaac377c][i:f8fc05a94087512b].\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance reported three complaints in a month because joint policyholder names weren't merged correctly [i:666838190e575148]. Tarnholt Drive Cover states the issue is triggering formal complaints [i:e6dc24086d5b5b70].\n- Linnet House Insurance reports manually editing letters before sending, which is time-consuming and prone to error [i:f8fc05a94087512b].\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance states letters come out with mismatched names [i:784bbcdb220c64b5]. Tarnholt Drive Cover confirms they're only pulling through one name, and it's causing complaints [i:e81e5ea9868dbaf4].\n- The issue is reported by all three routes: 8 mentions via support, 6 via sales, and 3 via account management [i:191159ac22dda8a3][i:45c010f06dcc57e3][i:7aef4ffdc807927e].\n\n## Why now\n- The problem is actively generating complaints and friction with clients, as reported by multiple accounts in September and October 2026 [i:99cd195f0e22561c][i:e6dc24086d5b5b70].\n- Three accounts have renewals approaching within the next 90 days, increasing the urgency to resolve a trust-eroding issue [i:685a9720c023a304][i:7aef4ffdc807927e][i:a63d773b605f22e0].\n- Stannary Commercial asked, Just need to know when we can expect the joint policyholder names to appear correctly in correspondence [i:99ed97781fb395fd].\n",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the headline figures against the fact sheet: six accounts, £5,580,000 ARR, 17 mentions, three routes with 8/6/3 split, and three renewals within 90 days (Stannary 2026-12-05, Tarnholt 2027-01-09, Hollinbrook 2027-01-15) — all match exactly. The Stannary quote in 'Why now' is verbatim from insight 99ed97781fb395fd, and the Hollinbrook 'three complaints in a month', Tarnholt 'formal complaints', Linnet manual-editing, and Callowfield mismatched-names claims are all directly supported by their cited quotes. The 'September and October 2026' timing claim is consistent with the insight dates (2026-09-03 through 2026-10-30). No overstated scope or omitted contrary evidence found.", "verdict": "pass"}
